_about: Hand-checked kick-off corrections for Frauen-Bundesliga games that OpenLigaDB has wrong. Applied by fetch_frauen_bundesliga.py (and the team feeds) on every refresh. kickoff_local is German time (Europe/Berlin). openligadb_last_update is the game's lastUpdateDateTime on OpenLigaDB when the correction was written: if OpenLigaDB edits the game after that, the correction is NOT applied and the refresh log warns, so a real DFB reschedule is never hidden. Once OpenLigaDB shows the same kick-off, the log says the entry can be deleted.
